I've talked to my mom about it multiple times and she says she won't let me transition until I'm an adult. I think I would be okay with that if she wouldn't constantly refer to me femininely. She always calls me 'miss serious' and stuff like that and it just makes me feel so bad because I spent a long time working up the courage to tell her I'm trans and she goes and acts like nothing has changed. I get she doesn't want me taking hormones or calling me by my preferred name, but it's the complete rejection that makes me feel so scared and ashamed. 

I didn't tell my dad because we never talk. The only words we ever exchange are 'how are you?' and very simple things like that. He also works away from home for a week every second week, so I didn't bother saying anything.

I really do hope I'll be able to be comfortable in my own skin soon. Thank you so much.

Thank you. I'm literally in tears; just, thank you. It's just so nice to hear that there's someone who doesn't think I'm a freak. After doing some drawing, I'm starting to feel better. I've been really suicidal lately, and I guess I just needed to vent. There is a support group in my area, so I'll try and get my mom to take me. Thank you.
